name: Stars
summary: The current star field, now on the forest ground, for comparison. It streams at you from a dark slit around the input, warps on send and pours into the line.
changes: Ground is night forest, landing on the hero's forest instead of black
The line's light is sun and sage instead of violet

name: Leaves
summary: Sage leaves blow across the screen on a gusting wind, tumbling as they go: near ones big and quick, far ones small and faint, all passing behind the input. On send the wind picks up, sweeps them into the line as it stretches to the rule, and they flatten out along it and vanish.
changes: Real sage-leaf shapes, with a midrib and veins, in five greens and one dried-gold
Tumble in 3D (they flip over as they fly), with depth and parallax
The gust on send is the same moment the stars used to warp

name: Sprout
summary: Sage sprigs grow in from the top and bottom of the screen towards the input, putting out leaves in opposite pairs as they climb, each pair turned a quarter to the last, the way sage actually grows. They sway, a yellow bud at each tip. On send they fold flat into the line.
changes: Says 'grow your ideas' before a word is read
Every sprig is different on every load

name: Fireflies
summary: Low mist drifts through the dark and fireflies wander in it, blinking. On send they all fly to the input's line, each a beat after the last, trailing light, and string out along it, so the fireflies are what light the rule. The mist clears as the hero comes up.
changes: Ironhill's 'watch the mist sit low' as an opening
Sun yellow carries the light into the line
The warmest and most atmospheric option

name: Contours
summary: A topographic map, its height lines slowly shifting, ringing the input like a summit: Ironhill's 'a place the maps don't show'. On send the land levels out, the rings straighten into level lines either side of the input, and they close up into the line as it stretches to the rule.
changes: Pure line art, the most editorial option
Echoes the untangle band in section 02: knotted lines, combed straight
The input sits on the summit: the idea at the top

name: Meadow
summary: Grass under the input, with waves of wind running through it, and pollen drifting in the air above. On send a gust lays the grass over and it sinks away, while the pollen is drawn into the line as it stretches to the rule.
changes: The input floats over a field, the hero rising out of it
Hundreds of blades in depth, moss at the back to sage at the front
Pollen in sun yellow and cream
